title: Task 4: Persist campaign rules binding and legacy defaulting
description:
Objective:
Store the authoritative campaign rules binding in SQLite and default legacy SRD-only campaigns safely.

Files:
- Modify: `packages/core/src/persistence/schema.ts`
- Modify: `packages/core/src/campaign.ts`
- Create: `packages/core/src/rules/binding.ts`
- Modify: `packages/core/src/index.ts`
- Test: `packages/core/test/campaignRulesBinding.test.ts`
- Modify: `packages/core/test/campaign.test.ts`

Steps:
1. Write failing tests that new campaigns persist a D&D SRD default binding, `getCampaign` returns binding identity, an existing schema-version-compatible campaign without binding reads as D&D SRD, and invalid empty campaign ids still fail.
2. Run `npx vitest run packages/core/test/campaignRulesBinding.test.ts packages/core/test/campaign.test.ts`; expected: FAIL because binding table/APIs do not exist.
3. Add singleton `campaign_rules_binding` to schema and bump `SCHEMA_VERSION` only if required by current migration policy. Because older schema versions currently fail compatibility, implement defaulting inside campaign read/create paths for same-version test DBs rather than silent cross-version migration unless the repo has added migration support.
4. Add `CampaignRulesBinding`, `DEFAULT_DND5E_SRD_BINDING`, `writeCampaignRulesBinding`, and `readCampaignRulesBinding`.
5. Extend `CreateCampaignInput` with optional `rulesBinding`; default to D&D SRD.
6. Extend `CampaignInfo` with `rulesBinding`.
7. Export binding APIs from `packages/core/src/index.ts`.
8. Run the focused tests; expected: PASS.
9. Commit with `git add packages/core/src packages/core/test/campaignRulesBinding.test.ts packages/core/test/campaign.test.ts` and `git commit -m feat-persist-campaign-rules-binding`.
acceptance_criteria: Focused campaign binding tests pass. Campaign DBs persist one base binding plus ordered add-ons JSON. Existing SRD-only same-version DBs without a binding are treated as D&D SRD campaigns.
close_reason: Added campaign_rules_binding singleton table (schema v6→v7), CampaignRulesBinding type with writer/reader and DEFAULT_DND5E_SRD_BINDING, threaded optional rulesBinding through CreateCampaignInput, surfaced it on CampaignInfo, and made getCampaign fall back to the default binding when no row exists. Verified: focused campaignRulesBinding + campaign vitest pass (10/10 RED→GREEN), full npm run typecheck and npm run test pass (368 passed, 2 documented skips).
